## Layout

- `healthcare/`: the Frappe app package (`app_name = "healthcare"`).
  - `hooks.py`: the integration hub. It wires install/migrate hooks, `doc_events` on ERPNext doctypes (Sales Invoice, Payment Entry, Company, Patient, and `*` for medical-record sync), `scheduler_events`, `override_doctype_class` (Sales Invoice → `HealthcareSalesInvoice`), jinja methods, website permissions, standard queries and global search.
  - `healthcare/healthcare/`: the single **Healthcare** module (`modules.txt`).
    - `doctype/<snake_name>/`: about 138 doctypes. Each has `<name>.json` (schema), `<name>.py` (controller class extending `Document`), optional `<name>.js` (form script), `_list.js` / `_calendar.js` / `_dashboard.py`, and `test_<name>.py`.
    - `custom_doctype/`: overrides and handlers for ERPNext doctypes (sales_invoice, payment_entry).
    - `api/patient_portal.py`: `@frappe.whitelist()` endpoints used by the Vue portal.
    - `report/`, `page/`, `dashboard_chart*/`, `number_card/`, `print_format/`, `web_form/`, `workspace/`, `module_onboarding/`, `setup/`.
    - `utils.py`: shared billing and invoice helpers called from hooks.
  - `controllers/`: shared base controllers (`service_request_controller.py`) and queries.
  - `regional/india/abdm`: regional (ABDM) integration.
  - `patches/v0_0`, `v15_0`, `v16_0` with `patches.txt`: data migrations run on `bench migrate`.
  - `public/js`: desk JS bundled via `healthcare.bundle.js`. `public/frontend`: built portal assets.
  - `www/`: website routes (`patient_portal.html/.py`, `patient-portal`).
  - `desktop_icon/`, `workspace_sidebar/`: Desk navigation JSON.
  - `tests/`: shared test bootstrap (`utils.py` → `HealthcareTestSuite`, `BootStrapTestData`).
- `patient_portal/`: Vue 3 SPA. It calls the server only through frappe-ui resources pointing at `healthcare.healthcare.api.patient_portal.*`, and listens on socket.io for `refetch_resource`.
- `wiki/`: design docs and user guides.

## Dependency direction

The portal SPA calls whitelisted API methods, which use the healthcare doctypes, which build on ERPNext (Item, Customer, Sales Invoice, Company) and then Frappe. ERPNext events flow back into healthcare through `doc_events` in `hooks.py`. **Business logic and validations belong on the server** (PR template); JS form scripts only handle UI.
